Native fixture: 17 x 13 RGB, 10-bit linear transfer, three visible frames.
Produced by imazen/jxl-encoder animation_contract lossless precision test,
fix/animation-request-contract branch based on 89efe733e2a598ae3ec10f92d4ef7089478ec357.
Every sample is checked against the authored integer formula in sendable_state.rs.
Independent decoder validation: libjxl v0.12.0, commit
a7a9c787341cf703dede03c2009fa460cae5e5df; every sample within half a 10-bit code.
The encoder PR records the final producer revision; this fixture does not use
any decoder output as its expected pixel source.
